nodes.label: Platform Flywheel (M1-M5 modules compounding into V1-V6 product lines)
nodes.rationale: Five shared reusable modules (M1 Radio, M2 DSP, M3 SysEng, M4 Embedded SW, M5 AI/ML) compound R&D leverage across six product verticals. Module reuse strength climbs from 25-60% in Y1 to ~99% by Y10, reducing marginal design cost toward software integration only. Total counterfactual standalone design cost ~Rs.1,350 Cr offset by ~Rs.994 Cr cost avoidance via reuse.
nodes.norm_label: platform flywheel (m1-m5 modules compounding into v1-v6 product lines)

nodes.label: V2: Electronic Warfare / SIGINT (ESM)
nodes.rationale: Day-1 cash engine with Rs.105 Cr opening order book. GSQR-compliant with Rs.200 Cr iDEX MoQ for 10 airborne ESM units in prototype trials. Generates operating cash from Year 1 funding downstream product development.

nodes.label: V6: Military AI Systems
nodes.rationale: Software-led product at 93-94% gross margin, attaches to every hardware sale. Ships from Year 1. Software mix drives terminal margin expansion to 67% blended GM by Year 10.

nodes.label: 10-Year Strategic Financial Model
nodes.rationale: Currency INR crores. Year-10 revenue Rs.5,055 Cr, EBITDA Rs.2,347 Cr (46.4%), cumulative 10-yr FCF Rs.4,803 Cr, project IRR 31.9%, NPV Rs.747 Cr. Total equity Rs.1,100 Cr. Gross margin grows from 51% (Y1) to ~67% (Y10). FCF-positive from Year 4.

nodes.label: ReuseMatrix (Platform Reuse Cost Avoidance Framework)
nodes.rationale: Maps each vertical to five shared platform modules and calculates how much vertical NRE is avoided through reuse. Total counterfactual standalone cost ~Rs.1,350 Cr, Rs.994 Cr avoided, Rs.575 Cr platform investment is the true capital expenditure.

nodes.label: BMAD Methodology Framework (v6.6.0)
nodes.rationale: BMAD v6.6.0 installed 2026-05-15. Modules: core (built-in), bmm (built-in), cis (bmad-creative-intelligence-suite), baut (bmad-story-automator), wds (bmad-method-wds-expansion). IDEs: claude-code, codex, cursor, auggie. Project name: Business Plans, user: Ap.

nodes.label: Backlog-Based Revenue Recognition Engine
nodes.rationale: Backlog sheet is the consolidated revenue engine. Bookings + opening backlog flow into deliveries, which become recognized revenue. Consolidated revenue sourced from Backlog!D89:M94 six per-vertical delivery rows. V-sheets are read-only supporting detail for unit economics only.
